title: Meter Shop Accuracy Standard: Overbilled Share of a Fast Electric Service by Rate Schedule Meter
content:
**Standard.** The overbilled share of an Electric Service by Rate Schedule meter found fast is the proportion of the billed energy treated as over-registered. It is figured from the error found by the latest fast test and the schedule's accuracy tolerance, which is 2.00 percent on all seven schedules, so that three times the tolerance is 6.00 percent.

| Error found and test history | Overbilled share |
|---|---|
| The error is at least three times the tolerance (6.00 percent or more) | The error percent divided by one hundred |
| The error is below three times the tolerance, and a test in the twelve whole months before the current date found the meter within tolerance | The error in excess of the tolerance, divided by one hundred plus that excess |
| Any other case | The error percent divided by one hundred plus the error percent |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Error found | Within-tolerance test in the twelve months | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 7.00 percent | Any | 7 divided by 100, that is 0.07 |
| 6.00 percent | Any | 6 divided by 100, that is 0.06 — equal to three times the tolerance |
| 5.99 percent | Yes | 3.99 divided by 103.99 |
| 4.00 percent | Yes | 2 divided by 102 |
| 4.00 percent | No | 4 divided by 104 |

### Hypothetical application to $780.00 of window energy

| Share | Amount, rounded to the cent |
|---|---|
| 0.07 | $54.60 |
| 2 divided by 102 | $15.29 |
| 4 divided by 104 | $30.00 |

### Points of reading

- The test history read is the within-tolerance tests on the same service account performed in the twelve whole months before the current date.
- The excess over the tolerance is the error found less 2.00 percentage points.
